map.对比多组工艺参数，选出“多次轻抛”的稳妥组合而非单次重压。: Compare several sets of process parameters and choose a safe many-light-passes combination rather than one heavy press.
map.亮度指数 = (转速 ÷ 1000) × 压力 × 遍数 × 100，结果限制在: Gloss index = (speed ÷ 1000) × pressure × passes × 100, with the result clamped to 0~100. Grades: ≥85 mirror gloss, 70~85 high gloss, 50~70 semi gloss, 30~50 matte, <30 dull. The index grows linearly with speed, pressure and passes.
map.转速 1500 rpm、压力 2、抛光 3 遍：指数 = 1.5×2×3×100: Speed 1500 rpm, pressure 2, 3 passes: index = 1.5×2×3×100 = 900, clamped to 100 → mirror gloss. With speed 800, pressure 1, 2 passes: 1×0.8×1×2×100 = 160 → still clamped to 100? By the formula (800/1000)×1×2×100 = 160 → clamped to 100. A low parameter combination such as 600 rpm, pressure 0.5, 1 pass = 0.6×0.5×1×100 = 30 → matte.
map.指数很容易封顶到 100 吗？: Does the index easily hit the 100 ceiling?
map.是的，三参数相乘增长很快，常见组合已达上限；因此该指数更适合比较“是否达到镜面效: Yes, the product of the three parameters grows fast and common combinations already reach the cap; so the index is better for comparing the threshold of 'has it reached a mirror effect' than for finely distinguishing between levels of high gloss.
map.为什么建议多次轻抛？: Why is many light passes recommended?
map.单次大压力会摩擦生热灼伤涂饰层甚至造成涂层剥落；分多遍、降低单遍压力可在达到亮度: A single heavy pass generates frictional heat that burns the finish layer and can even cause peeling; splitting into several passes with lower pressure per pass reaches the gloss while protecting the finish.
map.抛光亮度评估工具综合抛光辊速、压力与次数，估算皮革表面的亮度指数与等级，帮助制革: The Polishing Gloss Evaluation tool combines roller speed, pressure and number of passes to estimate the gloss index and grade of the leather surface, helping set reasonable parameters in the polishing step for the desired sheen.
